name: Computational Optical Imaging
description: Revision of fourier optics and basic concepts in optical imaging, mathematical preliminaries on inverse problems in imaging, compressive imaging, use of deep learning tools for optimization and design problems, point-spread function engineering, phase retrieval, interferometric imaging methods such as digital holography, imaging through turbulent media, super-resolution through structured illumination, correlation/ghost imaging.
